decks.name: LeetCode #19 - Remove Nth Node From End of List
decks.description: Remove the nth node from the end of a linked list in one pass

cards.question: Remove Nth Node From End of List: Given the head of a linked list, remove the nth node from the end of the list and return its head.

solutions.name: Two Pointers
solutions.explanation: Use two pointers with a gap of n nodes between them. Move both pointers until the fast pointer reaches the end. The slow pointer will be at the node before the one to remove. Use dummy node to handle edge case of removing head. Most efficient with single pass and O(1) space.

Skip the nth node from end by setting left dot next to left dot next dot next
Return dummy dot next as the new head

solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given list 1→2→3→4→5 and n=2: Create gap of 2: right at 3. Move both: left at 3, right at null. Skip node 4: 3→5. Result: 1→2→3→5.

solutions.name: Iteration (Two Pass)
solutions.explanation: First pass counts the total number of nodes, second pass navigates to the node before the one to remove. Simple two-pass approach with O(1) space but requires traversing the list twice.

Move cur forward by setting cur to cur dot next
Return head

solutions.name: Recursion
solutions.explanation: Recursively traverse to the end, then count backwards during backtracking. When count reaches zero, skip that node. Uses call stack to track position from end.
